Who we are

Built for players, not politics

NexGen Academy launched in 2025 with a simple idea: talented players across the DMV deserve a place to compete at a higher level, whatever club they call home during the season.

We bring players together for showcases, futsal and tournament play, then send them back to their clubs sharper, more confident and more visible. In our first year we competed from Delaware to Argentina.

About us

More than a team, a family

NexGen Academy is a club-neutral youth soccer academy based in Springfield, Virginia, serving U14 to U19 players across the DMV.

Our story

NexGen Academy was founded in 2025 by Steven Delcid with one goal: give talented players in the DMV more chances to compete, grow and be seen, no matter which club they play for.

In our first season we built teams across birth years 2006 to 2013, played the Copa Talento Showcase and the Delaware Super Cup, and started a futsal program. In summer 2026 we took our first international trip, to Argentina.

We're still early, and we're building something that lasts. Every event teaches us something new, and every player who wears the crest becomes part of the family.

What "club neutral" means

Keep your club

Players stay with their current club for the regular season. NexGen doesn't ask anyone to leave their team.

Add more games

We put together rosters for showcases, tournaments and futsal events, so players get extra high-level minutes.

Open to everyone

Players from any club in the DMV can try out. What matters is how you play and how you carry yourself.

What we stand for

FamilyWe look out for each other on and off the field.
DevelopmentEvery event is a chance to get better.
ExposureWe bring players to the events where they can be seen.
ExperienceFrom local showcases to international trips, we want players to see more of the game.

Our journey so far

  1. 2025NexGen Academy founded in Springfield, VA
  2. 2025Debut at the Copa Talento Showcase
  3. 2025–26Delaware Super Cup
  4. July 2026Second Copa Talento Showcase. 2012 squad reaches the quarterfinals
  5. Jul 26 – Aug 1, 2026First international trip, to Argentina
  6. Dec 26–27Copa Talento Futsal at St. James
